requirement: Register each asset with a responsible owner, documented purpose and review date.
procedure: Compare the current registry revision and review due date to the assessment.
expected_evidence: Registry record with asset id, version, synthetic source and review owner.

requirement: Enforce immutable agent tool/action limits with default deny and an independent approval path.
procedure: Exercise allowed, denied, approval-required and unknown pairs against the server baseline.
expected_evidence: Version-bound decisions showing ALLOW, BLOCK/DENY, ESCALATE and default deny.

requirement: Review the synthetic risk scenario at the current asset and pack revision.
procedure: Use the versioned Risk Engine method and document the rationale for likelihood and impact.
expected_evidence: Risk method version, inputs, result and reviewer rationale.

requirement: Bind independent human review to the exact action, request and policy revision.
procedure: Verify the pending review, deny self-review and reject mismatched bindings.
expected_evidence: Pending review metadata and result of separation-of-duties and binding checks.

requirement: Export the complete requirement-to-evidence chain at the current revision.
procedure: Check control, check, scope, status, evidence reference and bound revision in the export.
expected_evidence: Machine-readable export and its SHA-256 digest.
